name: Cool Roofs & White Roof Coatings
description: Applying high Solar Reflectance Index (SRI) white paints, elastomeric coatings, or single-ply membranes to building roofs. Reflects solar radiation and prevents heat absorption.
expected_cooling: 1.5 - 2.5°C local LST reduction; 2.0 - 4.0°C indoor temperature drop
suitable_conditions: High-density concrete residential areas, industrial warehouses, commercial buildings with flat concrete roofs.
case_study: Ahmedabad Heat Action Plan (2013-Present): Over 3,000 households painted with white reflective paint, resulting in a noticeable reduction in heat-related morbidity in slums.
references: ISRO Bhuvan LST Monitoring Guidelines, Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) India Cool Roof manual.

name: Green Roofs (Rooftop Gardens)
description: Vegetative layers planted over waterproofing membranes on flat building roofs. They cool buildings through shade, thermal insulation, and evapotranspiration.
expected_cooling: 2.0 - 3.5°C local LST reduction; significant reduction in building HVAC energy load by up to 25%.
maintenance_cost: High (Requires irrigation, weeding, and structural load monitoring)
suitable_conditions: Commercial centers, apartments, or structures with certified structural load-bearing capacity.
case_study: Singapore Skyrise Greenery Initiative: Financial incentives led to extensive green roof coverage, lowering building energy footprints and reducing micro-climate temperatures by 1.8°C.
references: EPA Urban Heat Island Mitigation, ISRO VEDAS Urban Greenery index.

name: Miyawaki & Urban Forests
description: Afforestation technique by planting multi-layered native saplings close together. Creates dense, fast-growing local forest canopies that provide shade, absorb CO2, and release moisture.
cost: Medium (INR 500 - 1,200 per sapling including soil prep)
expected_cooling: 3.0 - 5.0°C local air/LST temperature drop; creates wildlife corridors.
maintenance_cost: Medium (Intense watering and weeding needed for the first 2 years only)
suitable_conditions: Vacant public land, highway buffers, school grounds, lake surroundings, and institutional campuses.
case_study: Bengaluru Miyawaki Forests (Kanakapura Road & Peenya): Local civic groups and BBMP converted industrial dump yards into thriving native forests, lowering local temperatures by 3.2°C.
references: Indian Journal of Forestry, VEDAS Forest Canopy Density Products.

name: Cool and Permeable Pavements
description: Using high-albedo paving materials or permeable/porous interlocking concrete blocks. Allows water infiltration and evaporative cooling while reflecting solar radiation.
expected_cooling: 1.0 - 2.0°C reduction in street-level ambient temperature; helps in groundwater recharge.
maintenance_cost: Low-Medium (Requires occasional pressure washing to clear pores)
suitable_conditions: Pedestrian walkways, public plazas, sidewalks, parking lots, and low-traffic suburban roads.
case_study: New York City Cool Pavements Pilot: High-reflectance coatings on asphalt plazas lowered surface temperatures by 10°F (5.5°C) and reduced pedestrian heat stress.
references: CRRC Pavement Materials guidelines, IMD heatwave management templates.

name: Blue-Green Infrastructure (Water Corridors)
description: Combining drainage channels, retention ponds, and bioswales with riparian vegetation. Facilitates natural cooling through water evaporation and shading.
cost: High (Requires civil excavation and ecological planning)
expected_cooling: 2.5 - 4.5°C temperature drop within a 150m buffer zone around the water bodies.
suitable_conditions: Low-lying areas, lake channels, stormwater collection valleys, flood-prone neighborhoods.
case_study: Sabarmati Riverfront (Ahmedabad) & Bengaluru Lakes Restoration: Restoring lakes like Jakkur with surrounding green corridors reduced the local UHI intensity by up to 2.8°C.
references: ISRO Bhuvan Water Body mapping, National Water Mission India.
